The piece

Built like a wall, finished like furniture

A bar has to survive a party. This one is framed like a stud wall — 60 × 40 pine uprights every 400 mm — then clad in boards and capped with a 50 mm solid top that runs the full 3.50 m in one unbroken piece.

Pine arrives in Jordan in 4.25 m lengths, so that top needs no join anywhere along it. It is glued up from boards, planed flat, then wire-brushed to lift the soft grain and lightly distressed, so it reads as reclaimed timber rather than new stock. Three coats of hardwax oil go on it — the same finish used on kitchen worktops. Spills wipe off. In ten years a scratch is sanded back and re-oiled in an afternoon, which is something a lacquered top can never do.

The top overhangs the clad face by 300 mm. That is not styling, it is knee room. Without it a stool cannot pull in and nobody sits at the bar past the first drink.

Behind it: a 700 mm working aisle, then a back counter at 900 mm — deliberately lower than the bar, so whoever is pouring is not reaching up. The sink bay and the fridge bay are left open in the carcass and cut to whichever appliances you choose. Above them, an open cube unit on the wall for the bottles you want in reach.

The bar runs the full width of the space and dies straight into the wall on the left, so there is one way in and out of the service side — the right-hand end. Nothing gets walked through behind the bar, and the left end needs no finished panel because no one ever sees it.

A black steel pipe runs the whole length of the bar, 200 mm off the floor. Feet need somewhere to go.

Deliverables

Exactly what you receive

  1. Bar unit — 3500 × 700 × 1100 mm. Pine stud carcass, clad guest face, 50 mm solid top in one piece with a 300 mm overhang, three open bays with two fixed shelves each, one clad end panel (right), black steel foot rail. Runs into the left wall; service side entered from the right end only.
  2. Back counter — 3450 × 400 × 900 mm. 40 mm dark-stained top, five bays: open fridge bay, open sink bay, four soft-close doors, three internal shelves.
  3. Wall shelf unit — 900 × 900 × 250 mm open cube shelving, wall hung above the back counter.
  4. Finishing — hardwax oil throughout, three coats on the bar top, wire-brushed and lightly distressed.
  5. Delivery and fitting in Amman — scribed to the floor, levelled and fixed.

Not in the price: sink and tap · under-counter fridge · pendant lights · glass shelves and their LED strip · electrical and plumbing connection · bar stools — optional, quoted separately (see the three directions below).

Detail

Five things that decide whether it works

The top

3500 × 700 × 50 mm

Solid pine glue-up, one piece end to end. Eased edge, wire-brushed, three coats of hardwax oil. 300 mm overhang on the stool side.

The clad face

7 boards × 140 mm

Horizontal boards on a 60 × 40 stud frame, deliberately mixed in tone and set proud of each other so the face catches light the way reclaimed timber does.

The foot rail

Ø38 mm × 3500 mm

Black steel pipe on four flanges, 200 mm off the floor. Takes the scuffing that would otherwise land on the cladding.

The back counter

3450 × 400 × 900 mm

40 mm top in dark stain. Four soft-close doors with black pulls, an open fridge bay and an open sink bay cut to your appliances.

The shelving

2 per bay + wall unit

Two fixed working shelves in each of the three bar bays, hidden from the guest side. On the wall, a 900 × 900 open cube unit, wall hung above the back counter.

The finish

Hardwax oil, satin

Repairable, food-safe once cured, and it keeps the timber feeling like timber. Shown here in three tones — use the buttons above the model.

Optional

Five stools, three directions

Stools are not part of the bar price and nothing here is locked in. These are three directions to give you a feel for how the bar reads with each — switch between them on the model above. Once you know which way you want to go, we quote them separately.

A

Solid pine

The same pine as the bar. Square splayed legs, double stretchers, a 360 mm seat at 750 mm, hardwax oil to match.

B

Pine seat, black steel base

A round 370 mm pine seat, 45 mm thick, on a black steel disc base with a foot ring — the bar's timber and the foot rail's steel in one object.

C

Tan leather, black base

A padded tan leather seat on a black base with a foot ring, as in the reference photo. The softest of the three against all that timber.
